# Spec Workflow MCP AI Context Pack for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Aider

Pack version: `v1.0.0` · Last updated: `2026-05-14`

[![Pack v1.0.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/pack-v1.0.0-blue)](./CHANGELOG.md)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/tangweigang-jpg/doramagic-spec-workflow-mcp-pack)](./LICENSE)
[![Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/tangweigang-jpg/doramagic-spec-workflow-mcp-pack)](https://github.com/tangweigang-jpg/doramagic-spec-workflow-mcp-pack/issues)

Languages: English | [中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

Coding agents need executable specs, not vibes hidden in a chat thread.

This is an independent AI context resource pack for Pimzino/spec-workflow-mcp: host instructions, prompt preview, evals, pitfalls, and recovery rules you can load into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Aider, and other AI coding agents.

## The Problem

You shipped an AI coding agent into a sprint. Three days later it has drifted from the original requirements, built something close-but-wrong, and the human review caught it too late to recover without rewriting.

The root cause: **the spec lived in a chat thread, not in an executable workflow the agent could reference autonomously.**

`spec-workflow-mcp` is an MCP server that maintains structured specs as the agent works. This is an independent capability pack that gives you host instructions, evals, and recovery rules so you can load that protocol into any AI coding agent without pretending the upstream tool is already installed or endorsed.

## Copy / Run / Verify

```
1. Copy AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md for Claude Code) into your AI coding host.
2. Run the first prompt in 01_PROMPT_PREVIEW.md — no install needed to feel the workflow.
3. Verify behavior with 06_EVALS/smoke_check.md.
4. If it fails, recover with 03_PITFALL_LOG.md.
```

Quick links:
[Start](./AGENTS.md) · [Prompt](./01_PROMPT_PREVIEW.md) · [Evals](./06_EVALS/) · [Pitfalls](./03_PITFALL_LOG.md) · [Manual](./05_HUMAN_MANUAL.md)

## When This Pack Helps

Use this pack when you want an AI agent to load a spec-driven workflow protocol into an AI coding agent, with acceptance checks, step boundaries, and recovery rules for requirement drift without pretending the upstream tool is already installed, verified, or officially endorsed.

## What You Get

- Host instructions for AI coding agents (AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md).
- A copyable prompt preview (01_PROMPT_PREVIEW.md).
- Acceptance checks (06_EVALS/).
- Pitfall log and recovery steps (03_PITFALL_LOG.md).
- Boundary and risk card (04_BOUNDARY_RISK_CARD.md).
- Human reference manual (`05_HUMAN_MANUAL.md`) — architecture, components, and failure taxonomy.
- Source attribution and upstream links.

## AGENTS.md for Claude Code and AI Coding Agents

Use `AGENTS.md` for agent hosts that support repository instructions. Use `CLAUDE.md` when Claude Code is the target host.

## Pitfalls and Recovery

Start with `03_PITFALL_LOG.md` when setup, permissions, runtime behavior, or verification fails. Top 3 traps:
- **Windows npx path separator**: use `cmd.exe /c "npx @pimzino/spec-workflow-mcp@latest /path"` on Windows.
- **Dashboard step skipped**: start dashboard with `--dashboard` before the MCP server in Claude Desktop.
- **Missing `--` separator**: use `npx @pimzino/spec-workflow-mcp@latest -- /path` in Claude Code CLI.

Full log: [03_PITFALL_LOG.md](./03_PITFALL_LOG.md)

## Known Upstream Traps

- **Path traversal bug on Windows** (issue #220): may write outside approvals directory — verify before production use.
- **Arbitrary file read** (issue #201): fixed in some versions — check upstream before relying on file access.
- **Read-only `$HOME`**: set `SPEC_WORKFLOW_HOME=/workspace/.spec-workflow-mcp` before running.
- **Rate limit**: 120 requests/minute per client.

Full pitfall log: [03_PITFALL_LOG.md](./03_PITFALL_LOG.md)

If this pack helps your agent work from evidence instead of guesses, star the repo so future updates are easier to find. Open an issue for bugs, usage questions, or new pitfall reports.

## Source Attribution

This project pack was assembled by [Doramagic](https://doramagic.ai) to make Pimzino/spec-workflow-mcp usable as a portable AI capability asset.

- Upstream/source: https://github.com/Pimzino/spec-workflow-mcp
- License: GPL-3.0
- Pack contents: prompts, host instructions, checks, guardrails, and validation notes
- Relationship: independent capability pack; not affiliated with or endorsed by Pimzino/spec-workflow-mcp unless explicitly stated

If you maintain the upstream project and want attribution changed or removed, open an issue in this repository.
